snippet.title: Merge Critters Unite! Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP19 trailer for Merge Critters Unite! game.

Merge Critters Unite! - A swarm of dastardly demons have attacked a planet of adorable animals! These creatures have to unite, get stronger, and fight the evil horde to take their home back! Combine two of the same animal to get a new, stronger critter! Send your creatures off to fight and bring back gold and glory, then use that to buy even stronger animals with crazy weapons. Who will you add to your army in your quest? Coming soon.

2019
